1. Depict the scene in 3D, giving a sense of depth and volume.
2. Use the tilt-shift effect to blur the background while keeping the subjects sharp.
3. View the scene from a 45-degree angle, not directly overhead or at eye level.
4. Capture the essential details and atmosphere of the scene to make it instantly recognizable.
5. Ensure the image is highly stylized and exaggerated, like a miniature diorama.

Your image should evoke the spirit of the quote and scene without needing any additional context. It must be instantly recognizable to anyone familiar with the movie.

I understand that this task demands great visual imagination and technical proficiency with image styles. Take your time to fully visualize the scene in your mind's eye before committing it to the image.

Now, here is the movie quote for you to bring to life:

Quote: "You shall not pass!"

Please generate only the image. Do not include any text or prompts in your response.

Remember, clarity and style are paramount. The image must be highly polished and professional, befitting a masterful miniature diorama. I look forward to seeing your artistic interpretation of this iconic scene."
